bestBets.overview: At the time of writing (Sunday) the track is rated a soft 5 but with fine weather forecast an upgrade is anticipated. MASHEAN found one better at the short quote fresh but tried hard and is sure to have plenty of admirers again. LUMINOUS GIRL stuck on gamely after facing the breeze at Ipswich last time and appears the obvious danger. The debutante SEPURA EXPRESS has placed in her past two home track trials. Fellow first starter LOVELY GEM won her most recent trial at Toowoomba.

raceTips.comment: Thinking there's a couple of standouts here so the winner should come from either Mashean or Luminous Girl. Both horses resumed at Ipswich, running second and third respectively. Mashean worked hard to lead and kicked clear in the straight but the winner, who enjoyed the hot pace, reeled her in. Luminous Girl sat outside Mashean and was solid but will need to find a couple of lengths to turn the tables. Lovely Gem is a first starter who should be forward enough to run well after four trials. She looked good winning her most recent trial at Toowoomba. Sepura Express is another on debut who has shown ability in her trials.

bestBets.overview: LITTLE VAIN is proved when new and both of his wins have come at this, his home track. Respect any positive market moves. DON'T TOUCH tired from on speedy at Rocky third up but had scored at four of his five previous outings and must be given another chance. TERRIROTY ASH has found her second win elusive but is capable of sprinting well when new and was competitive in tougher affairs before the break. SHELLY'S ACE can mix form but is proved first up. Check for confidence in betting.

raceTips.comment: Sutherland is a short course specialist who will show her best back to the 800m scamper. In three starts over the Warwick 800m, she's won two and finished 2nd in the other. Every chance from the draw and Kenji Yoshida, who knows this mare well, gets back on board. Don't Touch has the most upside of any of these and could progress to city grade in time. She's won four from six including one over this trip. Territory Ash ran on well in a stronger race last start, finishing just outside of the placings. Hard to trust but a winning hope in this on best form. Shelly's Ace next best.

bestBets.overview: MAGNETIC ISLAND placed at huge odds fresh and proved it was no fluke with another sound effort in a small field at the Sunny Coast second up. She should be peaking now and maps to enjoy a nice trail just off the speed. BODYSNATCHER has the speed to lead these up and can take catching if allowed to dictate the tempo. BOWLING HARRY worked home okay when out to this trip at Doomben and this is an easier maiden. GRANDSTANDER made good ground from the back second up and the rise to 1350m looks suitable now.

raceTips.comment: In The Hole Tiger has looked the part in a pair of recent trials. His debut prep was plain but he's since been given time and looks to have come on significantly. Kaida Odori led and ran ok last start, boxing on for third. Set to improve off that. Willing to give Nukatabe a minor hope at big odds. She's had just the one start and was well held there but has since trialled well on the Gold Coast. Just needs some luck from the awkward draw. If You Asked Me To best of the rest.

bestBets.overview: SONIC FLYER found form quickly last time in and didn't run a bad race in that campaign. Expect a bold first up showing. Former Hayes Bros representative WIND BLAST has shown glimpses of ability in Victoria and any positive market moves must be respected at his local debut. FLIRTATIOUS LASS was game in defeat on debut before having little luck from a wide gate at her second attempt. She should get every chance to bounce back from the inside marble. OLIVERJOHNNY has been safely held in city maidens at his first couple but can improve in this easier affair.

raceTips.comment: Desert Angel was too far back to threaten at Grafton last start. Thinking she can improve stepping out to 1350m. She's also fitter and will carry 6kg less after the apprentice claim. Sonic Flyer has shown to be an honest mare early in her career. He's been around the mark in all four starts this prep, including a 5th in town at Eagle Farm, which is obviously strong form for a race like this. She seems to be quite versatile in where she can settle, so Taylor Marshall has options from the middle draw. Flirtatious Lass is right in this on her effort two back. The last start run was ordinary. The blinkers go on for this assignment. Oliverjohnny drops sharply in grade after two runs at Eagle Farm to kick off his career.

bestBets.overview: The speedy DONT CALL ME HONEY has only missed the quinella once in five previous fresh and was close up in a recent Deagon trial. He draws to advantage and should take plenty of wearing down. MISS DE MEDICI found the line nicely when kept safe at Ipswich fresh and is proved when second up. KINGSLAND performed consistently throughout his latest campaign and should enjoy a nice trail from his kind draw. BEE EXACT doesn't win out of turn but has been game in the placings of late.

raceTips.comment: Don't Call Me Honey flies fresh and gets the blinkers on for his first up assignment off a solid trial. From the draw, he'll be given every hope. Over Draft is a winning hope with luck from the gate. He is a horse on an upward spiral. Miss De Medici was sound first up in a deeper race. She is a previous winner here and blinkers go on for this.

bestBets.overview: ZARIPPA was twice game in defeat before getting too far back from a wide gate last start. He should take up a much more prominent position from the better draw and can hit back hard. WORLDLY SPIRIT found form quickly last time in but she does tend to give away a start so the inside marble may not be ideal. TASSORTIUM was never likely rising to metro company last time but this is much easier and she stormed home to clear maiden ranks second up. BRUTAL GLORY did enough when resuming and his sole win came when second up.

raceTips.comment: Nothing really stands out in this so will have a small each way bet on the resuming So You Can Torque. He has had a few key gear changes since his most recent run. He's been tuned up for this with a nice trial at Dalby. Water Lad is on the quick back up after working home nicely at Gatton on Thursday. He's suited staying at 1100m. Brutal Glory is a fit horse and will appreciate the class drop. Tassortium won well two back, showing off a booming finish to break the maiden. She was then tested in town but failed to fire. This is much more her go.

bestBets.overview: BEAU'S GIRL failed to finish off third up but had been game in the placings at her first two runs back from a long layoff and is deserving of another chance. HUMAN TOUCH was never likely second up but finished off hard to score fresh and can bounce back. STREET DAZZLER made good ground from the rear at Gatton last time and can get back into minors at least. TAYLOR'S RAGE will have her confidence up after taking an easier affair at Inverell and draws kindly.

raceTips.comment: Human Touch was disappointing last start but she's much better than that. Win nicely the start prior over 1050m so the step back in distance will suit. The lightly raced Street Dazzler was an eye-catcher last start after turning for home in last. She jumped out of the ground late. She's a fit mare and her best racing is still ahead of her. Dormelletto didn't beat much on debut but it was a sharp win. He looks to be a promising horse and even from the wide barrier and with a big weight, he'll take beating. Smaller chances given to Beau's Girl and Taylor's Rage.

bestBets.overview: LARUSSO was sound in tougher affairs at both runs last time in. He draws wide but has won when new previously and was close up in a recent home track trial. Keep him safe. BOLE LE closed well to place over 1200m fresh and both of his career wins have come at this longer trip. STANDLEE has been game in the placings at both runs back from a break and should be playing a role in the finish again with any luck from the wide gate. HEAVENLY LOVE has placed at two of three fresh runs and boasts a consistent record at this trip.

raceTips.comment: Larusso is a classy gelding but he has to contend with a tricky barrier first up. With luck, he could prove too good for these. He has better races in his future. The consistent Heavenly Love gets the blinkers applied for the first time here. He resumes after a couple of months off. He boasts a strong record over this trip. Standlee has come back well and looks ready to peak third up. A promising apprentice takes the ride and claims 2kg. Romantic Bubble goes in next.

bestBets.overview: Former Victorian REDCLOUD was never likely after getting back from a wide draw third up but had performed well at his first two local outings and should get every chance to bounce back from the inside marble. DON'T STOP ME NOW can hold the front from the favourable draw and be in it for a long way. RAINBOW GLITTER placed at big odds at Ipswich before working home okay without threat at Eagle Farm.

raceTips.comment: Zousain Girl weakened late last start at Ipswich after sitting p on the speed. Perhaps didn't see out the slightly longer trip so she's suited back in distance here. She's rock hard fit and is racing well this prep. This looks a nice race for her. Redcloud ran past a few late on the Sunny Coast but was a mile back, turning for home in last. His best efforts would definitely be good enough to take this out nd he maps for a soft run.
